transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Monday, September 28. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. New Green Card rules from September: Categories affected and those exempt. Beginning in September 2026, the USCIS unveiled new regulations affecting Green Card seekers. These guidelines emphasize the financial self-sufficiency of applicants while excluding those in humanitarian categories. Nearly all applicants, including family and various occupational groups, must satisfy these criteria. While the Form I-864, Affidavit of Support, is crucial, it cannot guarantee approval on its own. Louisiana neighbors' fight over 70-foot strip ends with $15K, dead cow stunt. In a prolonged conflict stemming from years of camaraderie, two families in Louisiana found themselves locked in a bitter legal battle regarding their property lines. The Colvins asserted ownership over a disputed 70-foot timberland strip, triggering rising tensions. Ultimately, the court sided with the Joneses, affirming the original boundary marked by an aged fence while ordering the Colvins to halt disruptive actions and compensate for damages. Balakot to Sindoor, India gave befitting reply: PM Modi on Pakistan terror. In a stern message to Pakistan, PM Modi said on Sunday the time when its role in sponsoring terror attacks on India would go unpunished is long gone, and his govt has made it clear with its actions, including Op Sindoor, that terrorists will be given a befitting response for their sinister designs against India. Bank unions call off 3-day strike after assurances, IBA to study demands. Bank unions called off their proposed three-day strike just before midnight after the Indian Banks Association agreed to look into their demands. Yellowstone rangers pulled 20,100 items from geysers, including 280 hats. Yellowstone rangers removed more than 20,100 pieces of trash from geothermal areas in 2026, along with over 5,000 rocks and sticks and 280 visitor hats. Staff also collected coins worth more than $18. Among the unusual finds were AirPods, golf tees, an inhaler, Invisalign retainers, fake nails and children's toys. Boeing flags 737 MAX glitch that may turn off auto pilot. Boeing has identified a software issue that could potentially lead to auto pilot disengaging during certain go-arounds (aborting landing to take off again and make a second attempt) on the B737 MAX when pilots change their planned altitude and path. Taylor swift's 'blank space' castle, oheka, heads to auction oct. 27. Oheka Castle, the sprawling 110,000-square-foot Long Island mansion featured in Taylor Swift's "Blank Space" music video, is headed to auction on October 27. The 127-room estate, built for financier Otto Kahn between 1914 and 1919, has also appeared in "Citizen Kane" and "Succession" and recently underwent a $40 million restoration. US Northeast battered by nor'easter as tidal surges flood homes, streets. A powerful nor'easter continued to batter the US Northeast on Sunday, bringing coastal flooding, strong winds and dangerous surf from New Jersey to New England, while disrupting power supplies and air travel across the region. india's most unusual train journeys: mountains, forests, rivers, deserts. India boasts a variety of extraordinary train journeys that weave through breathtaking landscapes and diverse terrains. From majestic mountains to serene valleys, each trip reveals unique attractions along the way. Iconic routes such as the Nilgiri Mountain Railway and the lavish Palace On Wheels showcase India's regal heritage. These scenic journeys not only reflect the nation's rich culture and history but also captivate the hearts of adventurous travelers. Abhishek's 30-ball ton hid the number that should really worry T20 bowlers. Abhishek Sharma's 30-ball T20I hundred against Afghanistan was spectacular, but the bigger story lies in the numbers around it. The India opener is striking at 194.55 while averaging 33.18, combining extraordinary aggression with consistency. His powerplay dominance, six-hitting, record-breaking numbers and the costly downside of his approach reveal how his game has evolved. PM's tribute to Ashok Singhal: 'A great personality committed to nation-building'. There is a beautiful saying that the tree does not consume its own fruit, nor does the river retain its waters.

Indore recorded 30,696 dog-bite cases at Hukamchand Polyclinic during the first eight months of 2026, including 4,024 in August alone, or nearly 130 daily.
